flows.pseudocode:
FLOW Microflow: Inspection.ACT_Assessory_Book
NODES=14; EDGES=12
1. START
2. DECISION IsStock? expression=$Accessory/AmountInStock != 0
3. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  4. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Accessory (AmountInStock=$Accessory/AmountInStock - 1; refreshInClient=false)
  5. DECISION AmountInStock > 10? expression=$Accessory/AmountInStock > 10
  6. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    7. ACTION CommitAction: commit Accessory (refreshInClient=true, withEvents=true)
    8. END
  9. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    10. DECISION AmountInStock = 0 expression=$Accessory/AmountInStock = 0
    11. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      12. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Accessory (EquipmentStatus=Inspection.ENUM_Accessory_Status.Out_of_stock; refreshInClient=true)
      13. END
    14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      15. ACTION ChangeObjectAction: change Accessory (EquipmentStatus=Inspection.ENUM_Accessory_Status.Almost_out_of_stock; refreshInClient=true)
      16. END
17. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  18. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=This assessory is currently out of stock., type=Information, blocking=true)
  19. END

NODES=14; EDGES=14
1. START
2. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Inspection.VAL_Task_Validate -> IsValid
3. DECISION IsValid? expression=$IsValid
4. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
  5. DECISION status is set to 'to do'? expression=$Task/Status = Inspection.Enum_TaskStatus.To_do
  6. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
    7. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToInspector
    8. NODE ExclusiveMerge: ExclusiveMerge
    9. ACTION CommitAction: commit Task (refreshInClient=true, withEvents=true)
    10. ACTION CloseFormAction: close page
    11. END
  12. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
    13. DECISION task set to 'done'? expression=$Task/Status = Inspection.Enum_TaskStatus.Done
    14. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=true
      15. ACTION MicroflowCallAction: call microflow Notification.SUB_Notification_SendToManager
      16. REF ExclusiveMerge
    17. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
      18. REF ExclusiveMerge
19. BRANCH when EnumerationCase=false
  20. ACTION ShowMessageAction: show message (text=Please fill out the required fields., type=Information, blocking=true)
  21. END
